reproduction_target: Population-genomic secondary analysis of An. gambiae WGS from the LLINEUP cluster-randomized ITN/PBO trial in Uganda, starting from Ag1000G phase-3 variant data accessed via the malariagen-data python package: PCA population structure, windowed FST (East vs West), effective-population-size (Ne) estimation via LD (r2) with subsampling, temporal nucleotide diversity (pi), and genome-wide allele-frequency selection scans tested with GLMMs (glmmTMB in R). Upstream alignment/variant-calling/phasing is the external Ag1000G production pipeline; physical entomological sampling and WGS are wet-lab (W, OOS for computational reproduction).
granularity_note: Coarse one-step-per-named-tool/analysis from biorxiv full-text Methods prose (JATS XML and landing page were HTTP 403/429; full text retrieved via curl of the v1.full HTML). Most population-genetic analyses (PCA, FST, LD/Ne) are described mathematically without naming a specific software package/version; only the malariagen-data python package (v13.0.0, from Data availability) and glmmTMB in R are named. The author code repository https://github.com/vigg-lstm/LLINEUP-genomics is cited as containing all analysis scripts but returns HTTP 404 (org/user vigg-lstm not resolvable), so no README prose could be read for env-capture claims. Wet-lab sampling/DNA/sequencing counted in W, not verdicted.

steps.label: External Ag1000G production pipeline (read alignment, variant calling, phasing) via malariagen vector-data ag3 methods URL — no version pinned in this paper
malariagen-data python package v13.0.0 — retrieval of Ag1000G phase-3 SNP/CNV variant data (sample sets 1288-VO-UG-DONNELLY-VMF00168 / VMF00219; Ag1000G site filters applied)
Principal component analysis on 100,000 randomly selected SNPs per chromosome arm — no software package/version named
Genome-wide windowed FST between Eastern and Western Uganda populations — no software package/version named

Effective population size (Ne) via LD (r2) on 100,000 SNP pairs across chr 2/3 (inversions/singletons/missing excluded; recombination rate 0.5; 1000-iteration 90% subsampling CIs; Mann-Whitney U) — custom, no software package/version named
Temporal nucleotide diversity (pi) computed with the malariagen-data python package (v13.0.0 per Data availability)

Genome-wide allele-frequency selection scans (biallelic SNPs MAF>5%, no missing, Ag1000G site filters) with GLMMs testing intervention phase/location/net type (fixed) and health sub-district (random) using glmmTMB in R — no glmmTMB or R version pinned

headline.inference_inclusive_upper_bound: RI ceiling on 2/7 computational steps (C2, C6 — both driven by the exactly-pinned malariagen-data python package v13.0.0). The remaining 5/7 steps cap at NI: PCA, windowed FST, and the LD/Ne analysis name no software package or version at all, and the GLMM step names glmmTMB in R without any version pin. No env lockfile, container, or conda spec is claimed; the cited author code repo (github.com/vigg-lstm/LLINEUP-genomics) is 404 so no README env-capture claim exists. Even under stage2 no step exceeds RI without an executed environment capture, and none is claimed.
headline.coverage: 7 computational analysis steps assessed from biorxiv v1 full-text Methods prose. 4 wet-lab/upstream physical steps (entomological sampling, DNA extraction, species-ID PCR, WGS library prep + sequencing) counted in W but out of computational-reproduction scope.

gaps.how_to_close: Provide a conda-lock/pixi lockfile or container digest pinning the full Python/R stack (numpy/scipy/scikit-allel/dask/zarr, R + glmmTMB, etc.) used for PCA, FST, LD/Ne, pi, and GLMM steps.

gaps.how_to_close: Name and version-pin every package (e.g., scikit-allel x.y, glmmTMB x.y, R x.y.z) in Methods or a versions table.
